@tanstack/react-start.message: Server functions need a server, and the native app has none — this works in dev and in an SSR deploy, then fails on iOS and Android. Move the logic to your API and call it over the network, or use a route `loader`, which is isomorphic. See docs/design/rendering.md §2.

@tanstack/react-start/server.message: The server-only entrypoint (getRequest, setCookie, setResponseHeaders, …) cannot run in an adaptv app — the native app has no server. See docs/design/rendering.md §2.
